qe: What is the capital of Bihar?
qh: बिहार की राजधानी क्या है?
e: Patna is the capital of Bihar.

qe: Bihar Diwas is celebrated on which date?
qh: बिहार दिवस किस तारीख को मनाया जाता है?
e: Bihar was separated from Bengal on 22 March 1912; Bihar Diwas is observed on this date.

qe: Valmiki National Park is located in which district of Bihar?
qh: वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Valmiki National Park lies in West Champaran district.

qe: Which major river flows through Bihar from west to east?
qh: बिहार में पश्चिम से पूर्व की ओर बहने वाली प्रमुख नदी कौन-सी है?
e: The Ganga flows across Bihar broadly from west to east.

qe: The Champaran Satyagraha took place in which year?
qh: चंपारण सत्याग्रह किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: Gandhi led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1917.

qe: Who was the first President of India?
qh: भारत के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति कौन थे?
e: Dr Rajendra Prasad was India's first President.

qe: On which date was the Constitution of India adopted?
qh: भारत का संविधान किस तारीख को अंगीकृत किया गया था?
e: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949.

qe: Which national symbol is the tiger of India?
qh: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पशु कौन-सा है?
e: The Bengal tiger is India's national animal.

qe: Which gas is released by green plants during photosynthesis?
qh: प्रकाश-संश्लेषण के दौरान हरे पौधे कौन-सी गैस छोड़ते हैं?
e: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.

qe: What is the SI unit of force?
qh: बल की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Force is measured in newtons (N).

qe: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
qh: सौरमंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह कौन-सा है?
e: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

qe: The Earth takes about how long to complete one revolution around the Sun?
qh: पृथ्वी सूर्य की एक परिक्रमा लगभग कितने समय में पूरी करती है?
e: One revolution takes about 365 days, or one year.

qe: In which year did India become independent?
qh: भारत किस वर्ष स्वतंत्र हुआ?
e: India became independent on 15 August 1947.

qe: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
qh: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
e: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757.

qe: What was the capital of the Mauryan Empire under Chandragupta Maurya?
qh: चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के समय मौर्य साम्राज्य की राजधानी क्या थी?
e: Pataliputra, present-day Patna, was the Mauryan capital.

qe: Golghar in Patna was built mainly for storing what?
qh: पटना का गोलघर मुख्य रूप से किस वस्तु के भंडारण के लिए बनाया गया था?
e: Golghar was built as a granary for storing grain.

qe: At sea level, water boils at approximately which temperature?
qh: समुद्र तल पर पानी लगभग किस तापमान पर उबलता है?
e: At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at about 100°C.

qe: Which part of a plant mainly absorbs water from the soil?
qh: पौधे का कौन-सा भाग मुख्य रूप से मिट्टी से पानी सोखता है?
e: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.

qe: What is 25% of 80?
e: 25% is one quarter; 80 divided by 4 is 20.

qe: What is three-fourths of 40?
qh: 40 का तीन-चौथाई कितना है?
e: Three-fourths of 40 is 3 × 10 = 30.

qe: A square has a side of 4 cm. What is its perimeter?
qh: एक वर्ग की भुजा 4 सेमी है। उसका परिमाप कितना होगा?
e: Perimeter of a square is four times its side: 4 × 4 = 16 cm.

qe: One kilometre is equal to how many metres?
qh: एक किलोमीटर में कितने मीटर होते हैं?
e: One kilometre equals 1,000 metres.

qe: In which direction does the Sun appear to rise?
qh: सूर्य किस दिशा में उगता हुआ दिखाई देता है?
e: Because Earth rotates from west to east, the Sun appears to rise in the east.

qe: The rotation of the Earth on its axis causes which daily event?
qh: पृथ्वी का अपनी धुरी पर घूमना किस दैनिक घटना का कारण है?
e: Earth's rotation causes the regular cycle of day and night.

qe: Who appoints the Governor of an Indian state?
qh: भारत के किसी राज्य के राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: The President of India appoints the Governor of each state.

qe: What is the National Song of India?
qh: भारत का राष्ट्रीय गीत कौन-सा है?
e: 'Vande Mataram' is India's National Song.

qe: Who wrote India's National Anthem, 'Jana Gana Mana'?
qh: भारत का राष्ट्रगान 'जन गण मन' किसने लिखा था?
e: Rabindranath Tagore wrote 'Jana Gana Mana'.

qe: The Revolt of 1857 began at which place?
qh: 1857 का विद्रोह सबसे पहले किस स्थान से शुरू हुआ?
e: The major uprising began at Meerut on 10 May 1857.

qe: Which practice helps reduce air pollution in a city?
qh: किस उपाय से शहर में वायु प्रदूषण कम करने में मदद मिलती है?
oh: खड़े वाहन का इंजन चालू रखना
e: Public transport can reduce the number of individual vehicles on the road.

qe: When water vapour cools and changes into tiny liquid drops, the process is called what?
qh: जलवाष्प ठंडी होकर छोटी जल-बूँदों में बदलती है। इस प्रक्रिया को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Condensation changes water vapour into liquid droplets.
